question: If the digits are not allowed to repeat in any number formed by using the digits <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mn>8</mn><mo>,</mo></math> then the number of all numbers greater than <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>000</mn></math> is equal to __________.
solution:
We have to form a number greater than 10,000 by using the digits 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, hence, the first place of the number can't be zero.

Thus, for the first place we have 4 choices i.e. 2, 4, 6, 8 and the remaining places can be filled with any of the digits, thus we have respectively 4, 3, 2, 1 choices.

Hence, using the fundamental principle of multiplication, the total numbers which are greater than 10,000 are

=4×4×3×2=96.

question: The sum of all the elements in the set <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>{</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>∈</mo><mo>{</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>,</mo><mn>100</mn><mo>}</mo><mo>∣</mo></math> H.C.F. of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>n</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2040</mn></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn></math>} is equal to __________.

The prime factorisation of the given number is 2040=23×3×5×17

The H.C.F. of n and 2040 is 1 if n is not a multiple of 2, 3, 5 and 17.

=100×1012-2×50×512+3×33×342+5×20×212+17×5×62-6×16×172-10×10×112-34×2×32-15×6×72-51-85+180

=5050-2550-1683-1050-255+816+550+102+315+51+85-180

=1251

Thus, the sum of all the required numbers taking the common elements only once, is  1+3+5+…..+99-3+9+15+21+……+99-5+25+35+55+65+85+95-17

Now, using the sum of n terms of an arithmetic progression i.e. Sn=n2a+l, where a is the first term and l is the last term.

=502100-172102-365-17

=2500-867-365-17
